title: successor assignment rejected: ^field inside a constructor
purpose: The construct is invalid and must not complete.

failure.justification: A declaration-level rule: the grammar lists it as a context-sensitive restriction checked after parsing, and an implementation may also detect it at registration/runtime. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.13 / 11.9: successor assignment is valid only inside successor actions and the field must exist (^field inside a constructor).
